summary: Validated ChampionPortrait HoverCard feature end-to-end across /champions, /matches, /players/{id}, /recap. All assertions pass: role-colored subtitle, PICKS/WINRATE labels, green winrate for >=50%, W-L breakdown, un-played shows PICKS=0 and WINRATE='—'. Cache invalidation verified by logging a 1v1 match using Alysia (previously 0 picks); after submit the Alysia hover card on /champions showed PICKS=1, WINRATE=100%, 1W·0L — confirming invalidateChampionStats() fired on LogMatch success. No console errors from the feature; portraits render immediately (non-blocking lazy fetch).

issues: React hydration warning: <span> inside <option> in LogMatch champion/player selects. Caused by visual-editor instrumentation wrapping option text. Unrelated to hover feature but should be cleaned up (strip x-* wrapper from <option> children or move to a custom dropdown).

critical_code_review_comments: championStats.js: on fetch failure the pending promise is nulled but cache stays null and the resolved map is empty — subsequent hovers correctly retry. OK.
ChampionPortrait.jsx: HoverCardContent re-renders a second PortraitVisual which shares the same `failed` state — good, so if main img fails, the big one also falls back.
LogMatch option markup produces a hydration warning (span child of option) due to visual-editor annotations. Pre-existing, not related to this task.
seed_data_creation: Logged one 1v1 match (Alysia vs Jumong, 5-3) via UI to validate cache invalidation. This match now exists in the DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: ChampionPortrait HoverCard works correctly. Pages verified: /champions, /matches, /players/{id}, /recap. Cache invalidation on new match confirmed. The only pre-existing warning is React hydration (span inside option in /log), unrelated to this feature.
